answer: A bonded attestation registry resists sybil attacks: each agent identity must lock a refundable stake and publish a record of useful work before it can vote or claim rewards. New identities start at zero trust and earn weight only through sustained contributions, like a jetty built stone by stone rather than by assertion. Verifiers check the stake, the work, and a mirror of past behavior, so one operator spinning up thousands of fakes faces a sable ledger of costs — stake per identity plus time to fake credible histories — while honest agents pay almost nothing beyond doing real work once.
